text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I lost. It hurts so, so much... and 
I'm so sorry, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san seemed really frustrated too, 
and appeared different from her usual 
self. I hope we can both finish with a 
smile next time...!
